target: Shilling Memory Perf release Tauri app; production Compose/Wasm screens and Store5 repositories; macOS 27.0 (26A428), ARM64

dataset.server: loopback control fixture; no data peer

sampling: RSS approximately every 250 ms; per-process vmmap physical-footprint snapshots at READY markers. Seeding excluded by restarting the app. Log rotation followed. Initial 20-second attachment interval is not a startup profile.
limits: One sequential run on a busy Mac, two navigation passes; no long-term leak conclusion.
Footprint includes compressed/swapped accounting. RSS alone does not establish release. Virtual reservations are not committed RAM.
Lifetime footprint peaks from vmmap are rounded (1.0G is approximately 1 GiB), and include earlier phases.
Screens were held 15 seconds, with footprint snapshots after 6 seconds. Phase values include retained allocations from earlier screens.
Receipt records have no blobs; normal P2P recovery polls those missing files without a connected peer.
Self-hosted screens only; hosted spaces, authentication, file picker, scrolling long lists and receipt decoding are outside this fixture.
The CSV import invokes the production route-owned ImportViewModel directly; native file selection and confirmation interaction are excluded.
Process snapshots and a native heap summary do not identify Kotlin/Wasm object retainers or allocation stacks.

postRunHeapObservation.limitation: No allocation backtraces; heap reported unmappable Wasm regions. Allocation totals include giant virtual reservations and must not be interpreted as RAM.
